Hello {client}, your quote {quote_id} for {product} is {quoted_price}. A deposit of {deposit} secures the date. Valid until {valid_until}.
Hello {client}, your quote {quote_id} expires on {valid_until}. Please tell us if you would like to go ahead.
Client: a smaller size fits your budget
Hello {client}, a smaller cake than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id} would lower the price. Shall we send a new quote?
Client: the price for your cake changes
Hello {client}, our prices change after {valid_until}. Your quote {quote_id} stays at {quoted_price} until then.
Client: a deposit secures your date
Hello {client}, a deposit of {deposit} secures your date for quote {quote_id}. The balance is paid at pick-up or delivery.

Hello {client}, quote {quote_id} includes the {decoration} decoration you chose: {quoted_price} for {product}.

Hello {client}, the price of {product} for your party is {quoted_price}. We can add a label or a ribbon on request.
Hello {client}, thank you for accepting quote {quote_id}. We will confirm the date and the details of {product} shortly.
Client: a larger cake for your guests
Hello {client}, if more guests come than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id}, a larger size avoids a shortage. Shall we price it?
Client: the seasonal menu and prices
Hello {client}, our seasonal menu and prices are ready. Order early in busy weeks so that we can keep your date.
Client: a bundle offer for your order
Hello {client}, adding a box of cupcakes or cookies to quote {quote_id} gives you a better price for both. Would you like to see it?
Hello {account}, the new wholesale price of {product} is {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Please confirm that you received it.
Account: a price change on butter items
Hello {account}, butter prices rose and the price of {product} changes to {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Thank you for your understanding.

Hello {account}, we would like you to try {product} at {wholesale_price} for a month. Please tell us if you want to start.
Hello, please confirm today's price for {item}. Our list shows {new_cost}. Thank you.
Supplier: your price rose, fix it for us
Hello, the price of {item} changed from {old_cost} to {new_cost}. Can we agree a fixed price for the next three months?
Supplier: a larger order, what discount
Hello, we plan a larger order of {item}. What discount can you offer on {new_cost} per unit?
Supplier: a quote for new boxes
Hello, please send a quote for new boxes and labels. Your current price for {item} is {new_cost}. Thank you.
Team: the recipe for a product changed
Hello {baker}, the recipe for {product} changed: {change_tried}. Please follow the new recipe from the next bake.
Team: weigh the new portion size
Hello {baker}, please weigh the new portion of {product} on the next bake and tell us the result.
Team: check the labour time for a job
Hello {baker}, {product} took {minutes_actual} minutes against {minutes_planned} planned. Please tell us what slowed the job.
Owner: a margin fell below target
Hello, the margin of {product} is {margin} against a target of {target}. Please check the price or the recipe.
Owner: a rise may need a price change
Hello, {item} rose by {change_pct} to {new_cost}. Please check which prices need to change.
Owner: a quote has had no reply
Hello, quote {quote_id} for {client} has had no reply for {days_open} days. Please follow up.
Owner: the monthly cost report is ready
Hello, the monthly cost report is ready. Check {product}: margin {margin}, cost per serving {cost_serv}.
Hello, the price list for the new quarter is ready. For example {product} is {price} before sales tax. Please tell us if you need the full list.
